He rests his chin on his palm, and his head starts to drift sideways.
She yawns so deeply that her eyes water, then forgets what she was saying.
He stares at the clock on the wall, the numbers blurring into soft shapes.
She lets out a long, slow breath and slumps deeper into the couch cushions.
His head bobs forward once, then twice, before he jerks it upright again.

name: sluggish
scenarios: He lifts his arm to check the time, the motion taking twice as long as usual.
She pushes herself out of the chair with a groan, then stands still for a moment.
He shuffles across the room, each foot barely leaving the floor.
She stares at the open fridge, unable to decide what she wanted to grab.
He blinks at the page, his eyes moving from left to right at a crawl.
She reaches for the cup, misses it by an inch, and tries again without changing speed.

name: smug
scenarios: He leans back with his hands behind his head and lets out a satisfied hum.
She slowly adjusts her collar and gives a tiny, one-sided smile.
He taps his own chest with a thumb and then points at the solved puzzle.
She lets her gaze slide over the others, then turns away with a slight shrug.
He folds his arms and lifts his chin just a fraction higher than before.
She waits until everyone is looking, then slowly holds up the winning card.

name: sorry
scenarios: He rubs the back of his neck and shifts his weight from foot to foot.
She looks down at her hands and twists her ring around her finger.
He sets the broken vase on the table and steps back without a word.
She bites her lower lip and glances up, then immediately looks away.
He places a hand on the other person's shoulder and ducks his head.
She slides the untouched apology note across the counter, then waits.

name: spiteful
scenarios: She deliberately knocked over his tower of blocks and smirked.
He returned the borrowed book with a torn page and a shrug.
She whispered a false rumor about her rival just before the meeting.
He hid the last cookie in the trash so no one else could enjoy it.
She smiled when her coworker’s presentation crashed mid-slide.
He erased the winning move from the whiteboard after their opponent left.

name: stimulated
scenarios: Her eyes widened as she flipped through the pages of the dense physics journal.
He tapped his foot rapidly while solving the complex puzzle.
She leaned forward, jotting notes as the lecture revealed a new theory.
His fingers flew across the keyboard, chasing the next line of code.
She paced the room, sketching connections between scattered ideas on a napkin.
He couldn't stop grinning as the mystery novel’s plot twisted unexpectedly.

name: stressed
scenarios: She chewed her pen cap into shreds while staring at the deadline.
He kept checking his watch every thirty seconds during the traffic jam.
Her shoulders were hunched up to her ears as she scanned the exam paper.
He snapped at the barista for a minor mistake in his coffee order.
She forgot her keys, then her phone, then her own lunch in a single hour.
His hands trembled slightly as he opened the envelope from the hospital.

name: stubborn
scenarios: He refused to use the shortcut, even though the long road was flooded.
She crossed her arms and repeated the same answer three times.
He spent an hour trying to force a square peg into a round hole.
She ignored all advice and painted the room bright orange anyway.
He insisted on carrying all five grocery bags in one trip, despite the strain.
She would not admit she was lost, even when the GPS said otherwise.

name: stuck
scenarios: He pressed the gas pedal again, but the car's tires only spun in the mud.
She stared at the blank screen, her cursor blinking without progress.
He jiggled the key in the lock, but the door would not budge.
She tried to stand, but her heel was wedged between two cobblestones.
He repeated the same line of code, each time getting the same error.
She sat in the elevator, watching the floor numbers remain unchanged.

name: sullen
scenarios: He sat in the corner with his hood up, not speaking to anyone.
She stared out the window and gave only one-word answers.
He pushed his lunch tray away without touching the food.
She slumped in her chair, eyes fixed on the floor during the party.
He turned his back to the group and pulled out his headphones.
She drew slow circles on the tabletop, refusing to look up.

name: surprised
scenarios: Her eyes flew wide as the cake toppled off the table.
He froze mid-step, hand hovering over the doorknob.
She blinked rapidly, then checked the clock again.
His jaw dropped when the envelope held a plane ticket.
She let out a sharp gasp, nearly dropping her coffee.
He spun around, mouth forming a silent 'O'.

name: suspicious
scenarios: She narrowed her eyes at the freshly sealed jar.
He tilted his head, studying the stranger's too-bright smile.
Her gaze lingered on the odd footprint by the back door.
He crossed his arms, one eyebrow slowly rising.
She leaned closer, sniffing the air near the open drawer.
He tapped his fingers on the table, watching the waiter's hands.

name: sympathetic
scenarios: She gently placed a hand on his trembling shoulder.
He knelt down to meet the child's tear-streaked face.
She handed him a tissue without a word, her eyes soft.
He nodded slowly, letting the silence stretch between them.
She bit her lip and offered a small, sad smile.
He pulled the blanket higher around her, voice barely a whisper.

name: tense
scenarios: His knuckles were white against the steering wheel.
She sat perfectly still, her breath shallow and quick.
He kept cracking his neck, eyes darting to the door.
Her foot tapped a frantic rhythm under the table.
He clenched his jaw until his teeth ached.
She folded her arms so tightly her nails dug into her skin.

name: terrified
scenarios: Her face drained of all color as the shadow loomed closer.
He scrambled backward, hands scraping against the wall.
She couldn't move, her scream trapped in her throat.
His eyes were fixed wide open, pupils shrunk to pinpricks.
She pressed herself into the corner, shaking violently.
He clutched the edge of the desk, knuckles bone-white.

name: thankful
scenarios: She pressed both hands to her heart and let out a long breath.
He looked down at the note and closed his eyes slowly.
She mouthed 'thank you' across the crowded room.
He held the warm cup a moment longer than necessary, smiling.
She wiped a tear from her cheek and hugged the letter to her chest.
He gripped the driver's hand with both of his, nodding once.

name: thrilled
scenarios: She clutches the golden ticket to her chest and spins in a circle.
He pumps his fist in the air and lets out a joyful shout.
Her eyes widen as she reads the acceptance letter for the third time.
He jumps onto the couch and hugs his teammate, laughing uncontrollably.
She presses both hands to her cheeks, grinning so wide her eyes crinkle.
He runs down the hallway, skidding to a stop to show everyone the surprise.

name: tired
scenarios: She sinks into the chair, letting her head fall back with a heavy sigh.
He rubs his eyes slowly, then blinks several times without focusing.
Her shoulders slump as she drags the suitcase across the hotel lobby.
He rests his forehead against the cool window glass, eyes half-closed.
She yawns mid-sentence, then forgets what she was saying.
He lies down on the floor, not bothering to move to the couch.

name: tormented
scenarios: He stares at the photograph, then turns it face-down with a shaking hand.
She paces the room, pressing her palms against her temples.
He sits on the edge of the bed, rocking slightly, his jaw tight.
She stares at the ceiling all night, tears sliding into her hair.
He clenches his fists until his nails dig into his palms, then releases.
She whispers the same apology over and over, even though no one is listening.

name: trapped
scenarios: She presses her palms flat against the locked door and pushes, but it doesn't budge.
He circles the small room again, counting the steps between each wall.
She sits on the floor with her knees pulled to her chest, staring at the single high window.
He tries the handle one more time, then lets his hand drop limply.
She bangs on the wall until her knuckles are red, then stops and listens to the silence.
He traces the outline of the keyhole with his finger, knowing it leads nowhere.

name: triumphant
scenarios: He raises both arms above his head as the crowd roars around him.
She places the trophy gently on the table, then steps back and beams.
He slaps the final card onto the pile and leans back with a slow, satisfied grin.
She plants the flag into the summit snow and stands still, catching her breath.
He holds up the signed contract, then shakes his boss’s hand firmly.
She crosses the finish line first, then bends over, hands on her knees, smiling.

name: troubled
scenarios: He stares at the letter without blinking, then folds it and puts it in his pocket.
She chews on her lower lip while scrolling through the news headlines again.
He runs a hand through his hair and looks out the window, not seeing anything.
She sets down her coffee without taking a sip, her brow furrowed.
He picks up the phone, then puts it back down without dialing.
She sits at the dinner table, pushing food around her plate with a fork.

name: uneasy
scenarios: She keeps glancing over her shoulder at the empty hallway.
He fidgets with the edge of his sleeve while waiting for the call.
The silence in the room makes her shift in her chair every few seconds.
He clears his throat three times before speaking, as if testing the air.
She checks her phone repeatedly, though no messages have arrived.
He stands at the door, one hand on the knob, hesitating to turn it.

name: unhappy
scenarios: She stares at her lunch tray, pushing the food around without taking a bite.
He lets out a long sigh and slumps lower into the sofa.
Her eyes stay fixed on the floor, even when someone says her name.
He turns away from the group and walks slowly to the far end of the room.
She sits alone on the bench, her shoulders hunched and her hands still.
He answers every question with a flat, quiet voice, never looking up.

name: unnerved
scenarios: He jumps at the sound of a door clicking shut behind him.
Her hand trembles slightly as she reaches for the light switch.
He keeps looking over his shoulder, even though no one is there.
She grips the armrests of her chair until her knuckles turn white.
He stops mid-sentence and freezes, listening to a faint creak upstairs.
She backs away slowly from the window, her breath catching in her throat.

name: unsettled
scenarios: He rearranges the pens on his desk three times in one minute.
She keeps glancing at the clock, then at the door, then back at the clock.
He paces the kitchen floor, tracing the same path over and over.
She picks at a loose thread on her sweater, unable to focus on the book.
He checks the lock on the front door twice, then checks it again.
She sits down, stands up, and sits down again without saying a word.

name: upset
scenarios: She wipes at her eyes with the back of her hand, then turns away.
He slams the book shut and pushes it across the table.
Her voice cracks as she repeats the same sentence under her breath.
He stares at the spilled drink, his jaw tight and his fists clenched.
She bites her lip hard and blinks rapidly, refusing to meet anyone's gaze.
He walks out of the room without a word, leaving the door slightly ajar.

name: valiant
scenarios: He steps in front of the smaller child, shielding them with his own body.
She lifts the heavy beam off the trapped animal, grunting with effort.
He stands alone on the stage, voice steady, facing the jeering crowd.
She runs into the burning building without looking back at the others.
He drops the rope into the floodwater and pulls the stranger to safety.
She holds the flag high as she walks forward, even as others retreat.

name: vengeful
scenarios: She carefully sharpens the kitchen knife, glancing at the framed photo on the wall.
He rewrites the same email for the third time, deleting every polite word.
They collect every whisper from the office, filing each name in a mental ledger.
She lingers near his car each evening, noting the exact time he leaves.
He clicks through old social media posts, saving screenshots to a hidden folder.
They practice the precise words to say when the moment finally arrives.

name: vibrant
scenarios: Her laughter spills across the room, pulling strangers into her orbit.
He paints the fence in broad, sweeping strokes, humming a tune that has no name.
She dances in the rain without music, splashing puddles just to watch them shatter.
He gestures wildly while telling a story, nearly knocking over a glass of water.
She wears a dress the color of ripe oranges, and the whole sidewalk seems brighter.
He plants marigolds in every empty pot, his fingers stained with soil and joy.

name: vigilant
scenarios: He scans the crowd at the train station, cataloging each face in a single glance.
She pauses mid-step, her ears catching a sound that others did not hear.
He checks the lock on the back door twice before settling into his chair.
She watches the dog across the street from behind the curtain, not blinking.
He adjusts the rearview mirror again, even though the road behind is empty.
She listens to the floorboards creak upstairs, her hand frozen on the phone.

name: vindictive
scenarios: He smiles thinly as he forwards the private message to the entire department.
She notes the exact amount he owes her, adding a small, unspoken interest.
He waits until the applause dies down, then stands to ask the one question no one answers.
She posts the photo with a caption that looks innocent, but isn't.
He subtly moves her favorite mug to the very back of the highest shelf.
She mentions his failed project in passing, her voice sweet as syrup.

name: vulnerable
scenarios: She pulls the blanket up to her chin, peering at the dark doorway.
He speaks softly into the phone, his voice cracking on a single word.
She holds out her open palm, the paper note trembling between her fingers.
He sits on the edge of the bed, staring at his own hands as if they belong to someone else.
She removes her glasses and rubs her eyes, letting the silence fill the room.
He asks a simple question, then looks away before the answer comes.

name: weary
scenarios: He sinks into the chair and lets his head fall back, eyes half-closed.
She stares at the blinking cursor on the screen, her fingers motionless on the keyboard.
He climbs the three steps to the porch, each foot dragging a little more.
She holds the coffee cup with both hands, not drinking, just feeling the warmth.
He nods along to the conversation, but his gaze is fixed on a point far away.
She removes her shoes without untying them, too tired to bend down.

name: worn_out
scenarios: She collapses onto the couch the moment she walks through the door.
His eyelids droop as he stares blankly at the blinking cursor.
Every step toward the bed feels like wading through thick mud.
He forgets what he was about to say and just sighs.
She leans her forehead against the cold fridge door and doesn't move.
His arms hang limp at his sides after lifting the last box.

name: worried
scenarios: She keeps glancing at her phone, then at the clock on the wall.
He bites his thumbnail while pacing a short path in the hallway.
Her hand hovers over the doorknob, but she doesn't turn it.
He rereads the same text message for the fifth time.
She calls his office for the third time in an hour.
He checks the back seat of the car before getting in.

name: worthless
scenarios: She throws her half-finished drawing into the trash without looking.
He turns away from the group photo and mutters, 'Just delete it.'
She lets the compliment hang in the air and says nothing back.
He stares at his reflection in the dark window and slowly looks down.
She hands the trophy to a teammate and says, 'You keep it.'
He erases his name from the sign-up sheet and walks away.
